set.body:
Objective

Permit cross-region or cross-subject effect forms only through explicit measurement legs into one named common measurement space.

Primary ownership

Bridge value/validation, relation/compiler preflight, kernel bridge application, receipts, docs, and numerical tests.

Deliverables

A measurement_bridge carries left_leg, right_leg, common_space, and provenance, inducing K = transpose(L_left) L_right. Same-space searchlights remain shorthand for identical legs. Bridge identity is part of scientific-plan hashing and result metadata.

Acceptance

Evaluation in common measurement coordinates equals direct K evaluation; the joint block constructed from measured relations is positive semidefinite within tolerance; transpose under bridge reversal holds; incompatible leg dimensions/common-space identities fail before source reads; distinct neural spaces without a bridge are rejected.

Non-goals

No arbitrary dense K API, learned alignment, hyperalignment, or group inference.
set.title: Add fixed factorized bridges between neural spaces
